name: Coconut Smoothie
desc:
Drops 10 splashes of Coconut Milk.
Coconut Milk has 30% Instant Conversion.
When stepping on Coconut Milk, receive Coconut Smoothie Boost for 15s
 (+25% Movespeed and x1.45 Obsidian Pollen).
Activates Every 15 Coconuts.

name: Sun Eclipse
desc:
Creates 4 Sunny Beams, which gather Pollen
 (Multiplied by Solar Pollen).
Additionally, receive Sun Eclipse Boost for 20s
 (x1.5 Pollen) & All players in the field receive
 Sun Eclipse Dual Boost for 20s
 (x1.05 Pollen & x1.1 Capacity Bonus) .Activates Every 80s.

name: Coconut Harvest
desc:
Creates 3 Coconuts, which gather Pollen and
 covers flowers in Milk.
Milk has 30% Instant Conversion.
Activates Every 20s.

name: Sunny Pulse
desc:
Creates 2 Sunny Beams, which gather
Pollen for each Hydrant (Multiplied by Solar Pollen).
Additionally, upgrades the flowers they gather for 12s.
Activates Every 30s.

name: Coconut Storm
desc:
Creates 3 Coconuts, which gather Pollen
 and covers flowers in Obsidian.
Activates Every 15 Swings.

name: Fire Aura
desc:
Covers flowers in Fire.
Activates Every 5 Swings.

name: Ice Aura
desc:
Covers flowers in Ice.
Activates Every 5 Swings.

name: Nature Harvest
desc:
Creates 5 Spikes around the field,
which gather Pollen and covers flowers in Obsidian.
Additionally, upgrades the flowers they gather for 15s.
Activates every 20 Swings.

name: Nature Charge
desc:
Activates Nature Charge Aura for 5s
(x1.2 Tool Speed and x1.2 Tool Pollen).
Activates every 45 Swings.

name: Colorful Splash
desc:
Turns shape of tool into random splash color.
Activates every 20 Swings.

name: Poison Harvest
desc:
Creates 5 Spikes around the field,
t which gather Pollen and covers flowers into Poison for 14s.
tPoison collects Pollen every second.
Activates every 20s.

name: Blossom Pollenation
desc:
Creates 8 Blossom Leaves around the field,
which gather Pollen for 12s.
Additionally, upgrades the flowers they gather for 12s.
Activates every 30s.

name: Art Splashes
desc:
Creates 3 colorful splashes randomly on field you stand on.
Activates every 30s.

name: Sticker Hunter
desc:
Creates random sticker on field & creates splash on that place.
Activates every 360s.
